subject: Ariba invite: W9 upload (zipped PDF) breaks SSO and blocks PO visibility
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@freemasonco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Problem accepting Ariba invite — login fails after I upload W9

Hi Marissa,

We tried to accept the Ariba invite this morning but the flow breaks after we upload the W9. The browser shows a SSO error (page redirects and then a generic "Authentication failed"). We zipped the W9 before attaching because the HR tool produced a 3.7MB PDF and our mail server strips big attachments. I attached the zip here: w9_signed.pdf.zip.

We were able to click the invite link and start the account creation, but at the final step (document upload / step 3) the page reloads to the login screen and we lose the session. Now the PO (PO-2024-4932) is not visible in our Ariba account and the payment team is blocked. Can you please advise urgently?

Attachments: w9_signed.pdf.zip (application/zip)

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Accounts Payable
Freemason Co
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@freemasonco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2024 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Problem accepting Ariba invite — login fails after I upload W9

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the file. Sorry for the interruption here.

Quick summary of next steps (we're escalating internally):
- Ben, can you take a look at Ariba's callback and SSO logs to see why the session is being dropped after the multipart upload? I logged SUP-2147 for tracking.
- Alicia: can you re-send the W9 as a raw PDF (not zipped) and with a filename that has no spaces or special characters (e.g., w9_signed.pdf)? If your mail gateway is the problem, you can also upload directly to this Ariba invite link: https://ariba.ariba.com/invite/ABC123 — I'll watch the logs while you retry.
- Temporary workaround: try the same flow in an Incognito browser or a different machine while we look into logs; sometimes proxies rewrite content-encoding headers and cause Ariba's SAML validator to reject the response.

We should have an update within the next business day. Ben/Karthik — please advise scope and ETA.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alicia Moreno <alicia@freemasonco.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 13:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Problem accepting Ariba invite — login fails after I upload W9

Thanks for the ping, Marissa. I pulled the Ariba SSO integration logs and I see a pattern: when the upload is sent with Content-Type: application/zip (or when the payload is wrapped in a zipped multipart), our SAML proxy does a redirect to the IdP but Ariba's relay state coming back doesn't match the expected transaction id. The proxy treats the request as a non-idempotent upload and sets a different session cookie. TL;DR — zipped uploads are interfering with the session handshake.

Actionable items:
1) Alicia: please upload the raw PDF directly via the invite link (https://ariba.ariba.com/invite/ABC123) or email the PDF to accounts+ariba@freemasonco.com and we will attach it on the vendor's behalf. Filename should be ASCII only, no spaces.
2) For the short term, we can accept the PDF on our side if you email it to accounts+ariba@freemasonco.com; I will attach it to your account and re-trigger the acceptance flow.
3) Internally: Karthik, I created SUP-2147 and added the error snippet (ariba-error-snippet.txt) to the ticket — looks like the content-encoding header is being rewritten by the vendor's gateway or our upload proxy. We'll plan a fix to tolerate zipped payloads or normalize headers, but that's a longer change (target: next sprint).

Logs referenced: ariba-sso-2024-06-24.log (internal)

Ben Carter
Integrations Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

I've attached the non-zipped PDF here for your records. Please confirm if you need anything else from our side to close the ticket.

Attachments: w9_signed.pdf (application/pdf, 378 KB)

Appreciate the quick help — Alicia
